maneuver_plan.objective: Reposition into a behind-ball, target-aligned setup lane, capture a controlled local setup, then execute local fetch only after deterministic push-ready validation.
replan_triggers: Ball or target pose confidence drops materially, or state age becomes stale during reposition/setup.
Corridor status changes, clearance degrades, or an obstacle appears on the approach or delivery line.
After reposition/setup, alignment remains outside push-ready tolerance or contact ownership cannot be established.
Unexpected ball motion, slip, or loss of controlled setup occurs before or during validation.
Delivery deviates from the expected corridor-to-target path or monitoring detects loss of controlled progress.
validation_gates: Perception freshness and confidence remain valid before motion: ball_confidence and target_confidence stay high and state_age remains within local planning tolerance.
Corridor remains usable for approach: blocked=false, unsafe_drift_m=0.0, and available clearance stays sufficient for a clean reposition/setup path.
Reposition ends in a behind-ball approach geometry with reduced lateral offset and yaw error relative to the ball-to-target line.
Local setup capture establishes robot-owned contact/control without direct uncontrolled ball impulse.
validate_push_ready must confirm target-aligned push geometry, stable contact ownership, and delivery path consistency before any local_fetch_to_pose begins.
